characters.name: English — Beholder bard
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE standalone full-body character concept LINE DRAWING on plain white paper, no background, no title or labels, no border, no second view or head study. Figure fully inside canvas with generous margins.
The attached first image is the user's own goblin drawing and the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE. The second is the user's own yeti drawing, secondary style reference. Reproduce that loose, economical, characterful draftsmanship much more closely than a finished fantasy illustration: grainy BLACK graphite strokes, variable pressure, a few searching contour lines and faint construction arcs, broad simple graphic shapes, assertive eyebrows and expressive heavy-lidded eyes, angular cheek/jaw/nose shapes, unexpected squash and stretch, broad lapels, simple hands, a lively balanced gesture. Leave most forms WHITE and unshaded. Only a little loose diagonal hatching and tiny dense black accents at brows, mouth and boot soles. Truly BLACK AND WHITE / neutral graphite only: no purple ink, no colored wash, no grayscale paint fills or digital gradients. Blank pure white surroundings. Line-led, not volume-rendered. Sparse confident drawing, not dense detailed engraving, not clean vector outlines, not polished comic inking, not photorealism, not 3D. Prioritize the user's hand-drawn shape design over conventional fantasy realism.
Draw only the character and the stated small hand-held/worn props. School/village/city-appropriate everyday costume, inviting teacher/student personality, strong silhouette, no armor. Full uncut feet, ears, horns and tail. Intentional sketch energy remains; accidental fused limbs, malformed fingers, or duplicate props do not.
SUBJECT: Male beholder English teacher: one floating round head-body with ONE soulful large central eye and ONE expressive raised eyebrow, little asymmetrical closed smile, swept top hair tuft and several curling eye-stalks with distinct simple small eyes. No humanoid torso, arms or legs. A long loosely draped scarf hangs and curls below; a small closed book rests in a sling against the underside. Warm witty scholarly attitude. Broad clear circular silhouette and long lyrical eyestalk curves, expressive squint and face anatomy in reference 1's drawing language. Fully uncut stalks and scarf.

characters.name: Technology — Mimic rogue

Edit the FIRST image, the mimic drawing. The second and third images are the user's original style references. Keep the loose sparse BLACK pencil linework on WHITE paper, friendly expression, small wrench and tool pouch.

One complete full-body chest creature alone, with generous white margins. No second view, no labels, no background or wash. Keep line density low and lively hand-drawn construction marks.
